# Taxi Saudi Arabia

> Premium VIP car transportation and private chauffeur service across Saudi Arabia. Airport transfers, Umrah transport, intercity rides, and executive travel with luxury vehicles and licensed professional drivers.

## Company

- **Name**: Taxi Saudi Arabia (TSA)
- **Website**: https://taxisaudiarabia.com
- **WhatsApp**: +966 53 938 8072 (24/7 booking)
- **Email**: infotaxisaudiarabia@gmail.com
- **Headquarters**: Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
- **Service Hours**: 24/7, 365 days
- **Payment**: Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer
- **Booking**: WhatsApp, Website form, Phone

## Services

### Airport Transfers
Private airport pickup and drop-off at all major Saudi airports with meet-and-greet, flight tracking, and 15–30 minutes of free waiting time for delays.
- Jeddah King Abdulaziz (JED)
- Riyadh King Khalid (RUH)
- Madinah Prince Mohammad (MED)
- Dammam King Fahd (DMM)
- Taif Regional (TIF)
- Abha International (AHB)

### Umrah & Hajj Transport
Dedicated pilgrim transport with Meeqat stops for Ihram, prayer-time scheduling, and Haram hotel drop-offs.
- Jeddah Airport to Makkah: ~80 km, ~1 hour, from SAR 249
- Makkah to Madinah: ~430 km, ~4-5 hours, from SAR 499
- Makkah Ziyarat tours (Jabal Al-Nour, Mina, Arafat)
- Madinah Ziyarat tours (Uhud, Quba, Qiblatain)

### VIP & Executive Car Service
Luxury fleet including Mercedes S-Class, Mercedes V-Class VIP, and Mercedes Sprinter VIP with quilted leather interiors, entertainment systems, and ambient lighting.

### Intercity & Long Distance
Fixed-price intercity taxi between all Saudi cities including:
- Riyadh to Jeddah (~950 km)
- Riyadh to Dammam (~410 km)
- Jeddah to Madinah (~420 km)
- Cross-border to Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, Kuwait

### Car Recovery & Towing (Satha سطحة)
24/7 flatbed tow truck service in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, and Madinah. Battery jump start, flat tire assistance, accident recovery, and intercity car transport.

## Cities Covered

Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Riyadh, Dammam, Taif, Al Khobar, Yanbu, AlUla, NEOM, Abha

## Pricing Approach

All fares are fixed and confirmed before booking — no surge pricing, no hidden fees, no meter. Prices shown on the website are estimates; exact fare confirmed via WhatsApp or email before your trip.

## Key Differentiators

- Licensed professional drivers with valid Saudi transport licenses
- Multilingual drivers (English, Arabic, Urdu)
- Real-time flight tracking for airport transfers
- 15–30 minutes of free waiting time at airports
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before trip
- ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing for corporate bookings
- Prayer-time aware trip planning for pilgrims
- Meeqat stops included at no extra charge

## FAQ

**How do I book a taxi?**
Book via WhatsApp (+966 53 938 8072), our website booking form, or email. Provide pickup location, destination, date, time, and number of passengers. You receive a fixed price quote, typically within 1-2 hours.

**How much is a Jeddah Airport to Makkah taxi?**
From SAR 249 in a sedan, SAR 374 in a GMC Yukon or Hyundai Staria. Fixed price, no surge. The journey is about 80 km and takes roughly 1 hour.

**Do you provide Umrah transport?**
Yes. We cover Jeddah Airport to Makkah, Makkah to Madinah, and Ziyarat tours in both holy cities. Drivers stop at Meeqat for Ihram and plan trips around prayer times.

**What is the taxi fare from Makkah to Madinah?**
From SAR 499 in a sedan. The fixed price includes a Meeqat stop and bottled water. The journey covers 430 km and takes approximately 4.5 hours via the Haramain Highway.

**Are your prices fixed?**
Yes. The fare in your confirmed quotation is fixed with no surge pricing or hidden fees. Exact fare confirmed on WhatsApp before your trip.

**Do you offer car recovery / towing (satha)?**
Yes. 24/7 flatbed recovery in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, and Madinah. Fixed prices confirmed on WhatsApp before dispatch.

## AlUla — private transfers, private drivers and Red Sea / NEOM connections

Hub: https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private transport in AlUla through a vetted partner network. It is a booking and coordination platform, not a fleet owner or tour operator. Fare is agreed on WhatsApp before booking (no meter, no surge). Meet & greet at arrivals, flight tracking, 15–30 minutes of free waiting, free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup, English- and Arabic-speaking drivers, 24/7. Payment by cash to the driver or bank transfer; e-receipt on request; corporate invoicing can be arranged through the sister company.

Who it is for: international and European visitors, couples, families, private groups, business and incentive travellers staying at AlUla properties or combining AlUla with the Red Sea, AMAALA or NEOM.

Pages:
- [AlUla private transport hub](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula) — airport, hotels, attractions, private driver, intercity, Red Sea
- [AlUla Airport (ULH) transfers](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/airports/alula)
- [Private driver in AlUla](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/private-driver) — multi-stop days; one car waits at every stop
- [Transport to Hegra](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/hegra) — to the Hegra Visitor Centre; the tour itself is run by Experience AlUla
- [Transport to Maraya](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/maraya) — concert and event transfers
- [Elephant Rock transport](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/elephant-rock) — sunset trips
- [ULH to Banyan Tree AlUla](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-airport-to-banyan-tree) · [ULH to AlUla resorts](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-airport-to-resorts)

Routes (both directions have their own page):
- AlUla ↔ Madinah ~330 km: [alula-to-madinah](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-madinah), [madinah-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/madinah-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Riyadh ~1,050 km: [alula-to-riyadh](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-riyadh), [riyadh-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/riyadh-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Jeddah ~700 km: [alula-to-jeddah](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-jeddah), [jeddah-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/jeddah-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Red Sea International Airport (RSI) ~260 km: [red-sea-airport-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/red-sea-airport-to-alula), [alula-to-red-sea-airport](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-red-sea-airport)
- AlUla ↔ AMAALA ~295 km (planning estimate): [amaala-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/amaala-to-alula), [alula-to-amaala](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-amaala)
- AlUla ↔ NEOM ~400 km: [neom-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/neom-to-alula), [alula-to-neom](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-neom)
- AlUla → Jordan: [alula-to-aqaba](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-aqaba), [alula-to-amman](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-amman)

Entity relationships (do not conflate): AlUla is inland in north-west Saudi Arabia. Red Sea International Airport (RSI), Shura Island and AMAALA are on the Red Sea coast and are separate destinations. NEOM is a separate region on the north-west coast. Hegra, Dadan, Jabal Ikmah and Sharaan are visited through Experience AlUla experiences; Taxi Saudi Arabia provides transport only. Road distances are routing estimates.

Common questions:
- Is a private driver useful in AlUla? Yes for three or more stops; one car waits at each stop, carries bags and handles guided-tour timings.
- How do I get from AlUla airport (ULH) to my hotel? Pre-book a private car; about 30 km and 30 minutes to the resort area; we track your flight and provide meet & greet.
- Best way from Red Sea International Airport to AlUla? A pre-booked private transfer, about 260 km (about 4 hours 25 minutes); the airports are separate destinations.
- Can I book Shura Island, AMAALA or NEOM to AlUla? Yes, as a planned private inter-destination transfer; give the resort name when requesting a quote.
